passage: Friday: Hemant and Omkar fought over the last mango slice, and Omkar called his big brother Hemant stupid. A cushion flew across the room. Saturday: They argued about the remote, about whose shoe was on whose side, and Hemant shouted, "You are the worst brother ever!" Omkar cried a little and stormed out. Sunday: The power went off in the rain. They dragged bedsheets and chairs into the middle of the room and built a fort by torchlight. "Sorry I said worst," Hemant muttered. "Sorry I said stupid," said Omkar. They lay inside whispering jokes until Mummy peeked in, smiled and switched off the fan.

qa.q: What did the brothers build on Sunday night?
qa.a: They built a fort out of bedsheets and chairs.

qa.q: What was Hemant feeling when he muttered his apology in the fort?
qa.a: He probably felt regret about the hurtful thing he said and wanted to make up, since he apologised first. 🙂

qa.q: What helped the brothers repair after two days of fighting?
qa.a: They apologised for the specific insults and then did something fun together, building the fort.

qa.q: How might Omkar have felt when Hemant called him the worst brother ever?
qa.a: Omkar cried a little and stormed out, so the insult hurt him even though the brothers made up later.

grounding: Two siblings fight for days and then build a fort together, mixing irritation and love.
